newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia, Germany sign investment protection accord.
newsitem.headline: Croatia, Germany sign investment protection accord.

text.p: Croatia and Germany signed an investment protection agreement on Friday, the Croatian News agency HINA reported.
It said the agreement represents the framework within which the two countries expand their active economic cooperation.

Germany is Croatia's main foreign trade partner with exports of $1.6 billion in 1996, and among major investors in the Croatian economy. Sales of Croatian goods to Germany totalled $893.5 million last year.
